name: Vallejera (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, white and green with a yellow triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Vallejera (a castle on red and a tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Vallejera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
